name: Replication Data for: "HyDRA-II: Spectroscopic results and BEsT guesses for the mono- and dihydrate blind challenge"
description: Experimental jet FTIR and Raman spectra of the HYDRA II test and bonus set systems & ORCA output files (ORCA version 5.0.4) for the lowest energy structures found including the xyz structures and inputs for the HyDRA training and test set at B3LYP-D3(BJ,abc)/def2-TZVP level of computation. DOI of preprint publication: https://doi.org/10.26434/chemrxiv.15001373/v1
